scope: P1 confirmed: follows, public profiles, in-app notifications, reply-gated text direct messages (five introductions before recipient replies), static-image moments, likes/comments, social reports and independent community moderation. Native APNs provides authorized, preference-aware alerts for social events and followed hosts starting voice rooms. No payments, gifts, VIP or realtime voice changes.
authentication: Ordinary account bearer, current adult legal consent and completed nickname. Operations endpoints require independent community Passkey permission.
privacy: Every ordinary social request fetches one signed, uncached voice policy snapshot; unavailable/malformed policy fails closed with 503. Bilateral blocked people are absent with 404 for direct lookup and omitted from lists/notifications. Login and account deletion never depend on social policy availability.

pagination: Opaque HMAC cursor derived from high-entropy account bridge material (legacy fixtures use Apple encryption key), bound to actor/filter/sort; expires24h. Conversations use pinned descending, updatedAt descending, id descending with strict conversations-v2 [pinFlag,updatedAt,id] cursor; legacy conversations two-key cursors continue the unpinned portion until refresh. Other lists preserve their existing two-key scopes; DM seq descending; operator reports ascending oldest first. Clear watermarks are applied before pagination and rechecked after policy fetch. List may be shorter after block filtering, follow nextCursor to exhaust. Unified inbox uses owner-bound inbox-v1 [pinFlag,activityAt,typedID], pinned private conversations first then descending activity and typedID; visibility and clear watermarks apply before LIMIT.

endpoints.behavior: Five committed introductory messages are allowed before the recipient replies; that first reply permanently unlocks the account pair while current account, consent, block and publication checks still apply. Follow/unfollow never gates sends. A sixth introduction returns403 detail object with code direct_message_reply_required, a user-facing message and the access metadata. A committed send consumes one slot atomically with message/outbox/receipt; failed transactions and exact UUID retries do not consume another slot. Block hides the whole conversation. Sender retry of a receipt already below their clear watermark returns404 and never revives cleared content. Successful send and receipt retry include current access metadata.

cleanup: Withdrawal or deletion removes both directions of follows, actor/recipient notifications, both sides of conversations and minimal DM introduction direction counters, authored moments/comments/likes, owned images and related report evidence. Logout retains persistent social data. Active timed posting restrictions survive withdrawal and expire automatically; account deletion removes them. Opaque case action audit remains bounded90days with target and reason unlinked; mutation UUID/hash receipts are bounded30days and actor-owned receipts are cleared on withdrawal.

nativePush.ownership: No client accountID. Authenticated current consented ordinary account session; no stale or invalid bearer. Same installation revision equal only identical source-session/body is idempotent, lower or changed equal409. Newer revision replaces old account/session; late old DELETE/logout/APNs410 cannot remove a newer generation. Device token encrypted Fernet at rest, installation UUID and token HMAC indexed. Per-account device cap10.
nativePush.preferences: Registration permission does not overwrite account notificationsEnabled. Disabling account pref immediately cancels pending sends; reenabling does not revive old sends. In-app records remain. hideNotificationContent defaults false; current nickname/text/interaction summary allowed unless hidden. Evaluated again immediately before payload generation; no preview stored in outbox.
nativePush.delivery: Business event and outbox same SQLite transaction. Stable apns-id/collapse-id; durable claimed lease committed before network. APNs200 means accepted only, not delivered/read. 429/5xx/network retry with bounded exponential delay; permanent4xx terminates. Invalid token removal conditional on original binding generation. Fresh bilateral block, current consent/session, sender eligibility, existing content, unread and committed DM checks before send; policy failure retries without sending. Muting/logout/deletion never sends stale content.
nativePush.destinationPrivacy: Requires current account session+consent; cross-account, deleted, read, blocked, ineligible or viewer-cleared content404. Only opaque deliveryID/accountTag provide routing in the system payload; preview text is not an access credential. room_started additionally rechecks the eligible follow, host consent epoch and signed active-room status outside transactions; outage503/retry, inactive404/cancel.
nativePush.operations: Top-level account dashboard push summary only: schemaVersion1,configured,enabled,activeDevices(valid consent/session binding, not online),pending(current),accepted(APNs200 last24h),failed(final failures last24h),recentFailures<=10(code,occurredAt). Never token/keyID/installation/account IDs or content.
nativePush.omissions: No photos, room names, rich-content extensions, Android push or guaranteed exactly-once delivery.

inboxActions: Per-account pin and clear state survives logout and synchronizes through authenticated GETs. Clear changes viewer visibility, not the peer retained messages or report evidence; underlying retention remains30days. Both clear and read high-water marks advance monotonically. Fresh sends or notifications alone restore entries. Cleared content does not contribute unread/badge or resolve old push destinations. Withdrawal/account erasure clears state and linked sequence mappings by foreign-key cascades. New clients display flat entries and use a pre-confirmation signed snapshot for read-all/clear-all, retaining that snapshot and UUID for uncertain retries. Legacy endpoints remain compatible for installed clients.

directMessageIntroduction.authority: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes access check, committed message, direction state, mutation receipt and push outbox. Read markers and local conversation clear never count as a reply.
directMessageIntroduction.state: social_dm_contact_state stores only account-pair direction counts, independent of message/conversation retention. Once both counts are positive the pair is unlocked. Established counters stop increasing; one-sided legacy history may exceed5 and is blocked until reply.
directMessageIntroduction.migration: On startup before the normal30-day message purge, retained legacy conversation directions backfill with monotonic MAX counts; repeated initialization never restores consumed allowance. Historical messages already erased before this upgrade cannot be reconstructed.
directMessageIntroduction.cleanup: Minimal handshake state survives logout, local clear and30-day message expiry to prevent quota resets; consent withdrawal or deletion erases both directions and account foreign keys cascade. No message bodies are retained beyond the normal30-day window.
directMessageIntroduction.push: Committed introductions have the same generic notification, unread, account/consent, bilateral block, sequence-clear and read safeguards as established messages. Follow/unfollow does not cancel DM outbox or destination/badge eligibility.

roomStarted.fanout: Voice durably records first confirmed real host/SFU presence once. Account freezes audience at f.created_at<=startedAtNs, checks current follow/account/consent/host epoch/bilateral blocks, commits event receipt+notices+push atomically. Repeated identical event returns original result without recreating deleted notices; changed payload under eventID or a new eventID for same room+host409. Receipt survives recipient withdrawal, but host withdrawal/deletion erases host-linked data.
